During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] maintained a '''third set of quarters''' on '''neg three four-thirteen''' of the '''bedrock levels''' in the [[Zorp House]] complex of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. On a floor reserved predominately for building workers, Lumiya's bedrock-level quarters were the most spartan of her [[Apartment three hundred seven twelve|three]] [[Lumiya's second apartment|abodes]], and served as a secret passage to and from Zorp House.
